consequence.statement: This is a new opt-in controller option. Nothing changes for operators unless they set it, and then the listed annotation keys are copied from Ingress or Gateway resources to the resulting Certificates.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds a new controller option, --extra-certificate-annotations. It lets you list annotation keys to copy from an Ingress or Gateway resource to the Certificate created from it.

checks.detail: cli-flag:cert-manager|name=--extra-certificate-annotations|component=controller: source render absent, target render absent — not visible with chart defaults
